_comment: TEMPLATE — the single fully-enabled Jscrambler config applied to every commercial-tier subject. The commercial tier does not run an ablation ladder (that is the open-source tier's job, §2.2); it turns on every protection at once to exercise the three capabilities a build-time open-source tool cannot: runtime protection (self-defending / debugging protection), usage/environment control (domain lock), and per-build polymorphism. Fill `accessKey`/`secretKey`/`applicationId` from your licensed Jscrambler account before running; keep this file out of any public release (it carries account keys). config/commercial.json points `build.config_file` here and records this file's hash with every build.
